notes: All six E2 manifests must be read, not regenerated.
Each valid E2 dataset needs local item text or a blocked row.
Each valid E2 dataset needs train/history interactions or a blocked row.
E3B is local text scoring only.
E3B does not train neural baselines.
E3B does not run LLM inference.
E3B does not call remote APIs.
E3B does not download data or models.
E3B writes CSV tables only and no raw JSONL outputs.
Plan C files and metrics must remain unmodified.
Scores must use the E3B schema when scoring is possible.
Metrics table must use the E3B schema.
Computed HR@5 values must be probabilities.
Computed NDCG@5 values must be probabilities.
E3B report classifies unverified BM25 as reconstructed BM25-like.
